The brief

Move between a contemporary street photograph, archive displays and material detail without presenting the images as a retail collection.

The layout approach

A clothing and textile lookbook study with tall crops and offset compositions.

  • Tall portrait format and asymmetrical image placement
  • Serif headlines and large editorial numerals
  • A practical image-selection checklist
